The **Ingram Mansion** was a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. 

The surroundings of the mansion have been cleared of the shrub and cultist accessories, as well as the Cultists that used to live here. The mansion itself has been boarded up and is inaccessible at this point in time. The terminal and other loot have been moved outside of it. A Brahmin is held in a pen on the eastern side of the mansion, with a Weapons Workbench being located on the western side.

- Come Back Soon - Note, on the unusable doors at the mansion.
- Chapter 8 - Holotape, on a wooden plank at the western side of the mansion.
- Cultist - Mind's Eye - Holotape, on a table behind the mansion, next to the terminal.
- One-time keycode - Unique generated keycode, found at a terminal behind the mansion, using the Nuka Cola marketing access code.

This location underwent remodeling on a few occasions:

- Prior to the *Wastelanders* update, it was inhabited by hostile robots, including Assaultrons, Mister Gutsys and Robobrains.
- Prior to the *Atlantic City Boardwalk Paradise* update, the place was inhabited by Cultists.
- With the *Atlantic City America's Playground* update, the entire property got re-worked into The Rose Room.

The Ingram Mansion appeared in *Fallout 76*.
